[size=5][b]✨ Why Stardew Farmer Previewer?[/b][/size]
Tired of launching Stardew Valley every single time just to test a 1-pixel adjustment on your custom shirt, hair, or farmer skin?

[b]Stardew Farmer Previewer[/b] is a [b]single standalone HTML file[/b] that runs directly in your browser. No web servers, no installations, no node.js required. Just open it and drag & drop your custom `.png` sprite sheets to preview all 58 in-game animations in real-time!

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Zero Installation / Standalone[/b]: Runs entirely offline in any modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Whale, Firefox). Single self-contained HTML5 file.[/*]
[*][b]58 Full In-Game Animations[/b]: Walking, running, tool swinging, watering, weapon attacks, fishing casting/reeling, eating, harvesting, emotes, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Accurate Layering Engine[/b]: Faithfully replicates vanilla Stardew Valley farmer drawing order: Body Base -> Pants -> Shirts -> Eyes -> Hair.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Texture Drag & Drop[/b]: Easily drag & drop your custom [i]farmer_base.png[/i], [i]hairstyles.png[/i], [i]shirts.png[/i], or [i]pants.png[/i] to inspect instantly.[/*]
[*][b]Precision Pixel Art Tools[/b]:
  - 2x to 10x crisp Nearest-Neighbor zoom
  - Frame-by-frame stepping & pause controls
  - Speed adjustment (0.25x slow motion to 2.0x)
  - Checkerboard, solid colors, and chroma-key backgrounds
  - 16x32 / 16x16 pixel grid toggles
  - Live Sprite Sheet tracker with bounding box[/*]
[*][b]Global 4-Language Support (i18n)[/b]: Real-time instantaneous UI switching between [b]English, 한국어 (Korean), 中文 (Chinese), and 日本語 (Japanese)[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🎮 How to Use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip [b]StardewFarmerPreview.html[/b].[/*]
[*]Double-click the HTML file to open it in your browser.[/*]
[*]Choose any of the 58 animations from the sidebar.[/*]
[*]Drag & drop your custom sprite sheets onto the canvas or load vanilla sample presets.[/*]
[*]Check your pixel alignment frame-by-frame with 10x zoom![/*]
[/list]
